claim: TypiClust step 1
value: Representation learning: first train a deep self-supervised task on $U_0 \cup L_0$, then use the penultimate layer of the resulting model as feature space.

claim: TypiClust step 2
value: Clustering for diversity: at each AL iteration $i$, we partition the data into $|L_{i-1}|+B$ clusters. This choice guarantees that there are at least $B$ clusters that do not intersect with the existing labeled examples (uncovered clusters).

claim: TypiClust step 3
value: Querying typical examples: we select the most typical examples from the $B$ largest uncovered clusters.
